text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm, aiming for Make a Debut, huh...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Going all-out recklessly isn't really my 
style, but still...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* One more rep! No, make it two 
more, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Next time—I'll land a blow on Opera 
O-chan! I'll break free from this string 
of narrow defeats.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-chan is so cool~. As expected of 
a GⅠ Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Even after winning the Kikuka-sho, she's 
always been a regular at the top of GⅠs, 
right? She's not just strong, she always 
gives it her all..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, me too! I've gotta try my best 
a little too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll do a teeny bit more 
self-training. Awaken, my super-duper 
amazing talent!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Creeeeak!!)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ahyabaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Hishi Miracle was resting in the 
nurse's office with a dejected look on her 
face.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, excuse me~. Guess I just got a 
little fired up~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I can do that too~!" I thought, so I did 
extra solo practice, but then I messed up 
my leg...
choice_data_list: I see. Just get some rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What's done is done. Fortunately, the 
injury was minor, so I decided to let them 
rest for a few days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chirp chirp, chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, vacation starts today, huh? Feels 
kind of restless, though~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer told me to rest, too. I've gotta 
behave myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chirp chirp, chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Day 3... The pain is pretty much gone now. 
But just in case...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I'll read through an onsen feature 
article today. Get well, get well soon~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how many days off has it been today? 
It should be time to... But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Having no training is the absolute best~ 
This is how my life used to be~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, my body is rejoicing. That's why, 
that's why~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chirp chirp, chirp...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Today I'm gonna train, I really want to. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To Trainer. The pain is a lot better, but 
it still feels a little off..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, 'It feels kinda weird!'. Like this? So 
today is... and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Quite some time had passed since her 
injury— but Hishi Miracle still struggled 
to return to the training track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's better than pushing it and 
making things worse. Left with no choice, 
I began thinking up a training menu on my 
own, when...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, colleague. Is Hishi Miracle 
still on break?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A trainer with a bit more seniority called 
out to me.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, it's about time to...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should look for a different 
Umamusume to train.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"It happens, you know. An injury can make 
an Umamusume's mindset drift back toward 
living an ordinary life."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Like May sickness or whatever? I mean, 
challenging races in the first place is 
unnatural anyway.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Even though they didn't have to, they 
pushed themselves to the absolute limit to 
take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could part of the reason Hishi Miracle 
hasn't returned... be that she simply 
doesn't want to come back?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I don't know. I don't know, but still..."

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You think so? You're free to believe that, 
but it might be tough on them too, you 
know? Besides—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
If you don't return, you'll also end up 
wasting precious time. Without an 
Umamusume to train.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without absolute certainty, there was 
nothing else to say. Because Hishi Miracle 
is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume I scouted and believed 
in. Her injury is surely just taking a bit 
longer to heal.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then at least set a deadline. Like 
how many days left, or something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then—a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah...?! Yes...!! I'm fine, it just hurts a 
li—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it doesn't hurt! I'm totally fine, 
really, see?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought it might be okay to slowly start 
up again... So, um...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...
choice_data_list:
If you're really cured, then that's 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
You're exaggerating... really. You're 
exaggerating...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wasn't it obvious I'd heal up? I mean, 
eventually, of course...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: —I'm the absolute worst...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I thought if I dragged it out any longer, 
everything would fall apart. That's why I 
tried to do something about it... But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I lied to Trainer. And what's worse, I 
never even told them the truth...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
This is... not good. It's really bad. 
So... yeah, I should apologize...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Wait, with what face are you saying that~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I could say that~! Like, 'I 
was actually all better, I was just 
slacking off~'?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Mom, Kuu-chan has been a bad girl. I 
can't even apologize. But..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"I think you're partly to blame too! If 
only you'd raised me more strictly. 
But..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer. I can't say it to your 
face, but... I won't do it again. I really 
won't do it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For how poorly I did this time, I'll make 
up for it little by little from now on. I 
know I will...!
